label: Hybrid: KV Set (Python, mutations)
description: Write plugin config kv.<key>=<val> via mutations. Outputs key for downstream.

template.source:
import sys
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, mutate, log, respond_ok, respond_error

read_request()  # available in hybrid runtime
key = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ''
val = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ''
key = key.strip()
if not key:
    respond_error('empty key')
    raise SystemExit(1)

mutate(f"kv.{key}", val, scope='plugin')
log(f"write kv.{key}={val}")
respond_ok('', extra={'outputs':[key]})

label: Hybrid: KV Get (Python, config)
description: Read plugin config kv.<key> and output val.

template.source:
import sys
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, config_plugin, log, respond_ok, respond_error

read_request()
key = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ''
key = key.strip()
if not key:
    respond_error('empty key')
    raise SystemExit(1)

val = config_plugin(f"kv.{key}", '')
log(f"read kv.{key}={val}")
respond_ok('', extra={'outputs':[str(val)]})

from lyenv_sdk import read_request, log, respond_ok, action, args, paths, system, config_plugin, config_global

read_request()
log(f"action={action()}")
log(f"args={args()}")
log(f"paths={paths()}")
log(f"system={system()}")
log(f"plugin.driver.name={config_plugin('driver.name','')} ")
log(f"global.env.name={config_global('env.name','')} ")
respond_ok('')

label: Hybrid: KV Set (Bash, mutations)
description: Bash node using lyenv_sdk.sh to write kv.<key>=<val> via mutations. Single output: key (message).

template.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source ./scripts/lyenv_sdk.sh

ly_read_request
key="${1:-}"
val="${2:-}"
key="$(echo "$key" | xargs)"

if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
  ly_respond_error "empty key"
fi

# write to plugin mutations: kv.<key>
ly_plugin_write_config "kv.${key}" "$val" "plugin"
ly_log "write kv.${key}=${val}"

# runner will use message as single output mapping
ly_respond_ok "$key"
